author: AstroPizza
body:
Hey , so ImRaging can't access the forums so he wanted me to appeal it for him on here. Please note this is all in his own words and i'm not associated with this infraction. The Temp-ban does run out today but he insisted i post it for him , so here you go. :)

I was recently temp-banned for 'abusing glitches' when I believe that i wasn't abusing them.
In a CTH game, I was the demo kit and happened to press the 4 key while scrolled over my crafting section of my inventory. Then I pressed escape and double the amount of eggs appeared in my hotbar. I immediately thought that I was lagging, so I spammed the eggs around. Turns out, I wasn't lagging. To see exactly what I had done, i did it again so I could later report the glitch on github I ./listed (to see if there was a mod in the game, and if so explain what i had done) and the mod that banned me was online. I MSGed him, explaining that I'd report it on github and that I wouldn't use it again. The mod seemed ok with it. Then, 1hr later I was booted off the server, and the temp-ban message came up. No warnings, no kicks. I was slightly confused as it said that i was banned an hour before i was booted off but that's not important.
If this was a mistake, I fully understand because everyone makes mistakes at times. I also understand that the mods are just trying to make AVN a better place and that he was doing his job. I feel that this was either a misunderstanding, lack of communication between me and the mod, or simply the guy doing his job.
Thanks for taking your time to read my appeal, Raging.
